name: Vehicle Loan Scheme (GTKVN)
benefit: Under this scheme, beneficiaries can avail of a loan of up to ₹4,00,000/- for the purchase of commercial vehicles such as auto-rickshaws, loading rickshaws, Maruti Eeco, etc.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Thakor or Koli community. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should intend to purchase an approved transport vehicle for commercial use.
